QuestInfo.name: Good Cook
QuestInfo.0: What will you need to do to become a cook accepted by Tangyoon? Try talking to Tangyoon in Tangyoon's Kitchen.
QuestInfo.1: Tangyoon tells you he will accept you as a true cook if you successfully complete 3 dishes selected by him. 5 ingredients must be put in without any mistakes! Make a dish worthy of the any foodie.
QuestInfo.2: You have been accepted as a good cook by Tangyoon!

0.0: You want to move up the ladder, you need MY approval. Show me you can cook 3 dishes without using the wrong ingredients, and we'll talk about your career opportunities.
0.1: I want you to cook something so good that it satisfies Mr. Chomps.

no.0: Cooking isn't just about eating, it's also about making people happy.

1.0: Not bad. I'm sure the Nautilus crew would be happy if you joined up... yeah, I guess that ain't gonna happen. Here's your medal.

yes.0: Nothing better than a good plate of grub.

default.0: You must cook at least 3 dishes without any wrong ingredients to be considered worth my time.
